Categories.Label: Buildings (printed VP)
Categories.Description: VP printed on each owned building (1-4 per building).

Categories.Label: Shipped goods VP
Categories.Description: 1 VP chip per good shipped on a galleon during Captain phase.

Categories.Label: Large building bonuses
Categories.Description: End-game bonuses from large purple buildings (Guild Hall, City Hall, Residence, Fortress, Wharf 2, Custom House, Harbor) — variable per condition.

Reasoning: Curated 2026-05-31 from Puerto Rico base game (3-5 players, ~120 min). NO dice (deterministic role selection). 5 goods types tracked per player (corn/indigo/sugar/tobacco/coffee). Doubloons + colonists + VP chips per player. Turn structure: each round, players take turns selecting one of 8 role cards (Settler/Mayor/Builder/Craftsman/Trader/Captain × 1 + Prospector × 2 in 5-player) — the chooser gets a privilege bonus, then all players execute the role action clockwise. Round ends when all 8 roles taken + governor token passes left. End-game triggered by: VP chips exhausted OR colonist supply exhausted OR any player fills the 12th building plot. Final scoring: buildings VP + shipped goods VP + large building bonuses (e.g., Guild Hall = 1 VP per small/large production building owned). Prospector 2 only present in 5-player variant.

ExcludedTools.Reason: Puerto Rico is deterministic role-selection, no dice involved.
No time limit per turn or round.
